summary: ViCi-FieldShift is a farm control centre for Ugandan farmers built on NASA Earth data. A farmer draws their fields and gets a health record for each one from NASA HLS satellite images, a farm calendar that sets planting, weeding, spraying, harvest and breeding windows from local seasons and the 7-day forecast with a Plan B for every job, and records for each animal's breeding dates and feed. It brings farm intelligence, planning, data, learning and simulation into one place: crop rotations simulated in usual, dry and changing seasons using 45 years of tested NASA rain, heat and greenness records; crop and animal disease identification; a crop, animal and breed wiki with short courses; and a map that connects the farmer to agricultural institutions, services, buyers and markets near them. For land buyers, lenders and planners it screens plots, finds sites and ranks Uganda's districts with published rules. Results come from published methods; AI assists only when switched on, and the vet and extension officer decide.
details:
What it does. ViCi-FieldShift is a full control centre for a farmer: farm intelligence, planning, data, learning and simulation in one place, built on NASA Earth data.

1. My farm. The farmer sets goals, draws fields on a satellite map and records animals by tag. Each field shows its greenness (NDVI) from NASA HLS v2 (30 m) for the last 12 months against the year before. The farm calendar builds planting, weeding, spraying, harvest and breeding windows from local seasons, checks each against the 7-day forecast and gives a Plan B when the weather does not come. Alerts flag heavy rain, heat, wind on a spray day and dry spells. Animal records give heat watches, due dates and daily feed. An ecosystem web shows what feeds what. Logged harvests, milk and eggs are compared with typical yields and the season's real rain, with advice on what to change.

2. Disease identification. Crop and animal health checks help a farmer recognise disease signs and decide when to call the vet or extension officer.

3. Wiki, breeds and learning. A crop and animal wiki with a breed identifier and short courses for each crop and animal on the farm.

4. Connections, services and markets. A map and directory that connects the farmer to agricultural institutions, extension and support services, buyers and markets near them, with a market page for selling produce.

5. Planning and simulation. Soil (iSDAsoil), slope (NASADEM), the farm's own rainy seasons (NASA POWER) and about two thousand two-year rotations scored on nine criteria, simulated in a usual year, a dry year and if today's trends continue.

6. Land, lending and planning. Site Finder, Parcel Check, land titles, and a National view ranking Uganda's 136 districts with published formulas; Urban growth from NASA Black Marble, MODIS land cover and GHSL.

7. Map and Trend Detective. Tested 45-year trends for every 10 km square in rain, temperature, soil moisture and greenness.

How it works. A Python service (FastAPI, xarray, rasterio, statsmodels, pymannkendall, pyet) computes results from published methods and fixed rules: Theil-Sen and Mann-Kendall trend tests, FAO-56 crop water use, cloud-screened NDVI per field, and calendar, livestock and advice rules in reviewable files. The website is Next.js with MapLibre, hosted on Vercel and Railway, with automated tests.

Benefits and impact. A farmer with no training gets each job at the right time with a fallback, sees which field is falling behind, finds the services and markets they need, and learns while farming. The tool says plainly when evidence is mixed.

NASA data: HLS v2, NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, GLDAS, MODIS MOD13A3 and MCD12Q1, Black Marble VNP46A4, GFSAD30, NASADEM, NASA GIBS. Partner and other data: ESA Sentinel-2, ESA WorldCover, Copernicus DEM, CHIRPS, iSDAsoil, OpenStreetMap, Open-Meteo, GHSL, UBOS, WFP food prices, geoBoundaries, FAO-56.

AI use: Claude Code (Anthropic) wrote and tested code to our specification. No AI model computes any number, ranking or rule shown to users; an optional assistant is off unless switched on.
